nodes.description: Public address state variable holding the governance/admin address, set to msg.sender in the constructor and used by the onlyGov modifier and as the rescue destination.
Mapping(address => bool) state variable recording which addresses are authorized fund managers; read by onlyFundManager and written by constructor, addFundManager and removeFundManager.
Constructor that sets governance = msg.sender and marks every address in _fundManagers as an authorized fund manager.
External governance-restricted function that sets fundManager[_address] = true.
External governance-restricted function that sets fundManager[_address] = false.
Governance-restricted function that reads the full balance of an arbitrary ERC20 token held by the contract and transfers it to governance.
Fund-manager-restricted function that loops over parallel arrays of recipients, reward tokens and amounts, transferring tokens and then notifying each recipient contract.
Modifier enforcing msg.sender == governance, guarding addFundManager, removeFundManager and rescue.
Modifier enforcing fundManager[msg.sender] == true, guarding distributeRewards.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks and as the emitter of the DistributedReward event.
External ERC20 safeTransfer call inside rescue that moves the whole token balance of an arbitrary token address to governance.
External ERC20 safeTransfer call inside the distributeRewards loop sending reward tokens to a caller-supplied recipient contract address.
External high-level call recipient.notifyRewardAmount(...) into a caller-supplied contract, executed after the token transfer inside an unbounded loop.
Address array constructor parameter whose entries are written into the fundManager mapping.
Address parameter of addFundManager that becomes an authorized fund manager.
Address parameter of removeFundManager that is de-authorized.
Arbitrary ERC20 token address passed to rescue and used for the balance query and transfer.
Calldata array of IRewardsDistributionRecipient contracts supplied by the fund manager; each element is called externally.
Calldata array of ERC20 token addresses supplied by the fund manager; each element is transferred.
Calldata array of token amounts supplied by the fund manager; each element is transferred.
Loop index used in the constructor to iterate the _fundManagers array.
Local variable holding the token balance of this contract before it is sent to governance in rescue.
Local variable caching _recipients.length and used for all three length-equality checks and loop bound.
Loop index in distributeRewards iterating over the recipients/tokens/amounts arrays.
Local variable holding the current element of _amounts for the transfer and notification.
Local variable holding the current element of _rewardTokens used for the transfer and notify call.
Local variable holding the current element of _recipients, a caller-supplied contract that is transferred to and called.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the untrusted value compared against the governance state variable in the onlyGov authorization check.
The governance state variable is read inside onlyGov to authorize privileged entry points.
The constructor assigns governance to the untrusted msg.sender, granting full admin rights to the deployer.
The constructor writes the governance state variable that gates all restricted functions.
The _fundManagers constructor parameter is iterated and consumed during initialization.
Addresses taken from the _fundManagers parameter are written into the fundManager authorization mapping.
The constructor loop index controls iteration over the _fundManagers parameter array.
onlyGov gates execution of addFundManager on msg.sender == governance.
onlyGov gates execution of removeFundManager on msg.sender == governance.
onlyGov gates execution of rescue on msg.sender == governance.
The caller-supplied _address parameter is granted fund manager privileges.
The caller-supplied _address parameter has its fund manager privilege revoked.
The fundManager mapping is read in onlyFundManager to decide whether msg.sender may distribute rewards.
msg.sender is used as the lookup key in the fundManager mapping inside onlyFundManager.
onlyFundManager gates execution of distributeRewards.
The arbitrary _rewardToken parameter drives the balance query and transfer in rescue.
The attacker-influenced token address is the target of the external safeTransfer call in rescue.
The token balance read into _balance is the amount passed to the external transfer.
The governance address is the recipient of the rescued tokens, tying privilege to fund movement.
The _recipients calldata array is consumed by distributeRewards and bounds the loop length.
The _rewardTokens calldata array is consumed by distributeRewards and length-checked.
The _amounts calldata array is consumed by distributeRewards and length-checked.
The length of _recipients is stored in local_len and used for all array consistency checks.
Each element of _rewardTokens is copied into the local_rewardToken variable.
Each element of _amounts is copied into the local_amount variable.
Each element of _recipients is copied into the local_recipient contract reference.
The caller-supplied amount is the value sent by the external token transfer.
The caller-supplied token address is the target of the external transfer.
The caller-supplied recipient contract address receives the tokens in the external call.
The external token transfer executes before the external notifyRewardAmount call, so a malicious token or recipient can re-enter before any state effects are finalized.
The reward token address is passed as an argument to notifyRewardAmount.
The reward amount is passed as an argument to notifyRewardAmount.
An arbitrary caller-supplied contract address is the target of the external notifyRewardAmount call, enabling reentrant execution.
Execution of distributeRewards reaches the in-loop external token transfer.
distributeRewards performs an external callback into a user-controlled contract inside a loop, allowing reentrancy during reward distribution.
The recipient contracts supplied in _recipients are invoked as external callbacks, so the caller controls the reentrancy target.
The loop index local_i governs each iteration that performs the external token transfer.
The loop index local_i governs each iteration that performs the external notifyRewardAmount call.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor-only initialization parameter; its dataflow is fully absorbed by the constructor that writes the fundManager mapping.
Single-use parameter of addFundManager; no independent semantic identity beyond that function.
Single-use parameter of removeFundManager; no independent semantic identity beyond that function.
Parameter used only to select the token moved by the rescue routine, so it collapses into that function.
Loop input array of distributeRewards; normalize into the distributing function.
Loop input array of distributeRewards; normalize into the distributing function.
Loop input array of distributeRewards; normalize into the distributing function.
Ephemeral loop counter of the constructor initialization loop.
Temporary balance holder directly feeding the external transfer in rescue.
Cached array length used only for checks within distributeRewards.
Loop counter that drives each external token transfer inside distributeRewards.
Per-iteration amount value consumed directly by the external transfer.
Per-iteration token address consumed directly by the external transfer.
Per-iteration recipient contract that is the target of the external notifyRewardAmount callback.
